FN-ARGH1Q7-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 178
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Mark Gidley
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/01/2025
House Bill 178 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of: (1) local boards
of education and the governing bodies of public institutions of higher education to determine the
display of the Ten Commandments in each school/institution, purchased with donated funds or
using a donated display; (2) the State Department of Education to identify and list free
resources available to local boards of education to comply with this bill; and (3) the State Board
of Education and the Alabama Commission on Higher Education to adopt rules pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.
